name: Eventbrite
description: Let your AI work with Eventbrite: list your events, attendees with check-in state, orders, ticket types, venues, discount codes and sales reports, and create, update and publish events, tickets, venues and event descriptions after you confirm.
instructions:
## Eventbrite
This connector works with the events of one Eventbrite account through the **Eventbrite API v3** (`https://www.eventbriteapi.com/v3`) with a private token: organizations, events, the event description, ticket types, attendees, orders, venues, discount codes and sales reports. It can create and update events, tickets and venues and publish or unpublish events after you confirm.

**Setup (about 2 minutes)**
1. Sign in to Eventbrite and open https://www.eventbrite.com/platform/api-keys (Account settings, Developer links, API keys). If there is no key yet, click **Create API key** and fill in the short form.
2. Copy the **Private token** (not the API key, client secret or public token) into `EVENTBRITE_PRIVATE_TOKEN` and install. It is sent as `Authorization: Bearer <token>` to www.eventbriteapi.com only.
3. Check the setup with `eventbrite_get_current_user`, then `eventbrite_list_my_organizations`.

The token acts as the Eventbrite user who created it, with all of their organizations: share the MCP server only with people allowed to see attendees and orders.

**How to work**
1. Start with `eventbrite_list_my_organizations`: almost every tool needs an organization_id (not the organizer id from a profile URL).
2. Events: `eventbrite_list_events` (default upcoming events; time_filter past or all for older ones), `eventbrite_get_event`, `eventbrite_get_event_description`.
3. Sales and guests: `eventbrite_list_ticket_classes`, `eventbrite_list_attendees` (with check-in state), `eventbrite_get_attendee`, `eventbrite_list_event_orders`, `eventbrite_list_organization_orders`, `eventbrite_get_order`, `eventbrite_get_sales_report` and `eventbrite_list_discounts`.
4. Building an event, each step only after the user confirms: `eventbrite_create_venue` (or pick one with `eventbrite_list_venues`), `eventbrite_create_event` (a draft), `eventbrite_create_ticket_class`, `eventbrite_set_event_description`, then `eventbrite_publish_event` to go live. Change things later with `eventbrite_update_event` and `eventbrite_update_ticket_class`; `eventbrite_unpublish_event` takes an event offline while it has no orders.
5. `eventbrite_cancel_event` and `eventbrite_delete_event` are installed switched off; an administrator turns them on deliberately. Both only work while an event has no orders.

**Dates**: send times in UTC as `YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ` (no milliseconds) together with the event timezone (`Europe/Berlin`). Answers carry `start.local`, `start.utc` and `start.timezone`.

**Prices**: ticket costs are `CURRENCY,amount in the smallest unit`: `EUR,2500` is 25.00 EUR. Answers show amounts as objects with `display` (e.g. "€25.00").

**Paging**: list answers have `pagination.has_more_items` and `pagination.continuation`; pass `continuation` for the next page.

**No public search**: Eventbrite removed public event search from the API in 2019, so this connector only sees events of the user's own organizations.

**Common errors**
- 401 INVALID_AUTH: the token is wrong or revoked, or the API key was pasted instead of the private token.
- 403 NOT_AUTHORIZED: the user has no permission for this organization or event.
- 400 ARGUMENTS_ERROR and similar: a field is invalid; `error_description` names it (e.g. DATE_CONFLICT, VENUE_AND_ONLINE, CANNOT_UNPUBLISH, PAGE_VERSION_DISCONTINUITY).
- 404 NOT_FOUND: no such event, order or organization for this user.
- 429 HIT_RATE_LIMIT: 2,000 calls per hour per token; wait and retry.

**Out of scope here**: refunds, check-in through the API, inventory tiers and reserved seating, ticket groups, custom questions, webhooks, media upload, series schedules and copying events.
prerequisites: An Eventbrite account that organizes events, and its private token from Account settings, Developer links, API keys. About 2 minutes.

EVENTBRITE_PRIVATE_TOKEN.label: Private token
EVENTBRITE_PRIVATE_TOKEN.help: Eventbrite, Account settings, Developer links, API keys: the Private token (not the API key or client secret). Paste it without the Bearer prefix.
EVENTBRITE_PRIVATE_TOKEN.patternMessage: Paste the private token as Eventbrite shows it: letters and digits only, no spaces or Bearer prefix.

verifyHints.401: Eventbrite refused the token (INVALID_AUTH): it is wrong or revoked, or the API key or client secret was pasted instead of the Private token from the API keys page.
verifyHints.403: Eventbrite accepted the token but this user may not do this (NOT_AUTHORIZED).
verifyHints.429: Eventbrite's limit of 2,000 calls per hour for this token is reached. Wait and verify again.

tools.name: eventbrite_get_current_user
tools.description: Return the Eventbrite user the private token belongs to: id, name, emails. Free and the quickest check that the token works. Read-only.

tools.name: eventbrite_list_my_organizations
tools.description: List the organizations the user belongs to: id, name, vertical. Almost every other tool needs an organization_id from here (it is not the organizer id from a profile URL). Read-only.

continuation.description: pagination.continuation from the previous answer, for the next page (only while has_more_items is true).

tools.name: eventbrite_list_events
tools.description: List the events of an organization, filtered by status and time: id, name, start and end (local and UTC with timezone), status (draft, live, started, ended, completed, canceled), url, currency, capacity, online_event, venue and, with expand ticket_availability, prices and sold-out state. Public event search across Eventbrite no longer exists in the API; this lists your own events. Read-only.

organization_id.description: Organization id from eventbrite_list_my_organizations (not the organizer id).

status.description: Event status, or several comma-separated (e.g. live,started). Default all.

name_filter.description: Only events whose name contains this text.

expand.description: Comma-separated expansions, e.g. venue,ticket_availability (lowest and highest price, sold out, sales start). Also organizer, category, format, refund_policy, event_sales_status.

continuation.description: pagination.continuation from the previous answer, for the next page (only while has_more_items is true).

tools.name: eventbrite_get_event
tools.description: Get one event with its name, summary, dates, status, url, currency, capacity, listing settings, venue and ticket availability (with the default expand). For the long description use eventbrite_get_event_description. Read-only.

expand.description: Comma-separated expansions, e.g. venue,ticket_availability (lowest and highest price, sold out, sales start). Also organizer, category, format, refund_policy, event_sales_status.

tools.name: eventbrite_create_event
tools.description: Create a new event as a draft in an organization. Confirm the name, dates, timezone and currency with the user first. The event stays unpublished (not visible, no sales) until eventbrite_publish_event; add tickets with eventbrite_create_ticket_class and the long description with eventbrite_set_event_description before publishing. Set venue_id (from eventbrite_list_venues or eventbrite_create_venue) or online_event true, not both. Returns the new event with its id.

organization_id.description: Organization id from eventbrite_list_my_organizations (not the organizer id).

start_utc.description: Start in UTC, YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ without milliseconds, e.g. 2026-11-20T18:00:00Z.

end_utc.description: End in UTC, same format, after the start.

timezone.description: Timezone of the event, e.g. Europe/Berlin or America/New_York.

currency.description: ISO 4217 currency for tickets, e.g. EUR or USD.

summary.description: Short plain-text summary, up to 140 characters.

online_event.description: true for an online-only event without a venue.

venue_id.description: Venue id; leave out for online events.

listed.description: false to keep the event out of Eventbrite search (default true).

invite_only.description: Only invited people can see the page (cannot be combined with listed true).

capacity.description: Total capacity; leave out to use the sum of the ticket capacities.

organizer_id.description: Organizer profile id; leave out for the default organizer.

category_id.description: Category id, e.g. 103 Music, 102 Science & Technology, 101 Business.

format_id.description: Format id, e.g. 1 Conference, 2 Seminar or Talk, 9 Class or Workshop.

locale.description: Language of the listing page, e.g. de_DE, en_US, it_IT (default en_US).

tools.name: eventbrite_update_event
tools.description: Change an event's name, dates, summary, venue, capacity or listing settings; only the fields you pass change. Show the user the changes and confirm before calling: a live event changes for everyone who sees or bought it. Dates take an object with timezone and utc. Currency cannot change once paid tickets are sold. Returns the updated event.

end.description: New end as {"timezone": "Europe/Berlin", "utc": "2026-11-20T22:00:00Z"}; same timezone as start.

summary.description: New plain-text summary, up to 140 characters.

invite_only.description: Only invited people can see the page.

tools.name: eventbrite_publish_event
tools.description: Publish an event: it becomes visible and its tickets go on sale. Confirm with the user first. Publishing needs a name, a description, an organizer, at least one ticket class and, for paid tickets, payout settings; otherwise Eventbrite answers 400 naming what is missing. Returns published true.

tools.name: eventbrite_unpublish_event
tools.description: Unpublish an event: it is no longer visible and stops selling. Confirm with the user first. Only possible while the event has no pending or completed orders (a completed and paid-out paid event can be unpublished). Returns unpublished true.

tools.name: eventbrite_cancel_event
tools.description: Cancel an event for good. Only possible when it has no pending or completed orders (refund them first). Installed switched off: an administrator turns it on deliberately. Show the event with eventbrite_get_event first and call only after the user confirms. Returns canceled true.

tools.name: eventbrite_delete_event
tools.description: Delete an event for good. Only possible when it has no pending or completed orders. Installed switched off: an administrator turns it on deliberately. Show the event with eventbrite_get_event first and call only after the user confirms. Returns deleted true.

tools.name: eventbrite_get_event_description
tools.description: Get the long description of an event (its structured content): page_version_number and the modules (text with HTML, images, videos) and widgets (agenda, FAQs). This is the latest working version, published or not. eventbrite_set_event_description needs page_version_number + 1 as version (1 when there is no version yet). Read-only.

purpose.description: listing (the event page, default) or digital_content (online event page).

tools.name: eventbrite_set_event_description
tools.description: Replace the long description of an event with one HTML text block and publish it. This replaces every existing module (images and videos too), so read eventbrite_get_event_description first, keep what should stay in the HTML, show the user the new text and call only after the user confirms. version must be the current page_version_number + 1 (400 PAGE_VERSION_DISCONTINUITY otherwise; read the description again and retry). HTML allowed: paragraphs, bold, italics, links and lists.

version.description: New version: page_version_number from eventbrite_get_event_description plus 1, or 1 for the first description.

html.description:
The description as HTML, e.g.

Doors open at 7 pm.

publish.description: true (default) makes the new text visible on the event page; false saves it as a draft.

tools.name: eventbrite_list_ticket_classes
tools.description: List an event's ticket types: id, name, free or cost (with fee and tax), capacity, quantity_sold, sales start and end, on_sale_status, hidden, min and max per order. Read-only.

continuation.description: pagination.continuation from the previous answer, for the next page (only while has_more_items is true).

tools.name: eventbrite_create_ticket_class
tools.description: Add a ticket type to an event, free (free true) or paid (cost such as EUR,2500 for 25.00 EUR in the event currency) with a capacity. Confirm name, price and quantity with the user first. Paid tickets need payout settings in Eventbrite before the event can be published. Returns the ticket class with its id.

free.description: true for a free ticket (leave cost out).

cost.description: Price as currency and amount in the smallest unit, matching the event currency: EUR,2500 is 25.00 EUR.

capacity.description: How many of this ticket can be sold.

sales_start.description: Sales start in UTC, YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ; default when the event is published.

sales_end.description: Sales end in UTC, YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ; default one hour before the start.

hidden.description: Hide this ticket from the event page.

include_fee.description: Absorb the Eventbrite fee into the price.

sales_channels.description: Where it sells: ["online"], ["atd"] (at the door) or both.

tools.name: eventbrite_update_ticket_class
tools.description: Change a ticket type: name, price, capacity, sales dates, limits per order or hidden; only the fields you pass change. Confirm the change with the user first. The price cannot change once tickets were sold. Returns the updated ticket class.

free.description: true for a free ticket (leave cost out).

cost.description: Price as currency and amount in the smallest unit, matching the event currency: EUR,2500 is 25.00 EUR.

capacity.description: How many of this ticket can be sold.

sales_start.description: Sales start in UTC, YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ; default when the event is published.

sales_end.description: Sales end in UTC, YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ; default one hour before the start.

hidden.description: Hide this ticket from the event page.

include_fee.description: Absorb the Eventbrite fee into the price.

sales_channels.description: Where it sells: ["online"], ["atd"] (at the door) or both.

tools.name: eventbrite_list_attendees
tools.description: List the attendees of an event (one per ticket sold): id, name, email, ticket type, status (Attending, Checked In, Not Attending), checked_in, cancelled, refunded, order_id and the check-in state of each barcode. Barcode values are left out. Read-only.

status.description: attending (attending or checked in), not_attending, or unpaid.

changed_since.description: Only attendees changed at or after this UTC time, YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ.

continuation.description: pagination.continuation from the previous answer, for the next page (only while has_more_items is true).

tools.name: eventbrite_get_attendee
tools.description: Get one attendee of an event with profile (name, email, phone, company, job title), ticket type, cost, status, check-in state per barcode and answers to the order form questions. Barcode values are left out. Read-only.

tools.name: eventbrite_list_event_orders
tools.description: List the orders of an event: id, buyer name and email, status, created time, gross, base price, Eventbrite fee, payment fee and tax. Read-only.

status.description: active (attending, default), inactive (not attending), both, or all_not_deleted.

changed_since.description: Only orders changed at or after this UTC time, YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ.

continuation.description: pagination.continuation from the previous answer, for the next page (only while has_more_items is true).

tools.name: eventbrite_list_organization_orders
tools.description: List the orders across all events of an organization: id, event_id, buyer name and email, status, created time and amounts. Use changed_since to look at recent sales. Read-only.

organization_id.description: Organization id from eventbrite_list_my_organizations (not the organizer id).

status.description: active (attending, default), inactive (not attending), both, or all_not_deleted.

changed_since.description: Only orders changed at or after this UTC time, YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ.

continuation.description: pagination.continuation from the previous answer, for the next page (only while has_more_items is true).

tools.name: eventbrite_get_order
tools.description: Get one order with buyer, status and the full cost breakdown; expand attendees to see the tickets in it, event for the event. Read-only.

tools.name: eventbrite_list_venues
tools.description: List the saved venues of an organization: id, name, address, capacity and age restriction. Use the id as venue_id when creating or updating an event. Read-only.

organization_id.description: Organization id from eventbrite_list_my_organizations (not the organizer id).

continuation.description: pagination.continuation from the previous answer, for the next page (only while has_more_items is true).

tools.name: eventbrite_create_venue
tools.description: Save a new venue in an organization so events can use it. Confirm name and address with the user first. Returns the venue with its id.

organization_id.description: Organization id from eventbrite_list_my_organizations (not the organizer id).

address.description: Address: {"address_1": "Hauptstr. 1", "address_2": "", "city": "Freiburg", "region": "BW", "postal_code": "79098", "country": "DE"}; latitude and longitude as strings may be added here too, never at the top level.

google_place_id.description: Google Place id of the venue, if known.

tools.name: eventbrite_list_discounts
tools.description: List discount, access and promo codes of an organization: id, code, type, amount_off or percent_off, how many are available and used, validity dates and the event or ticket classes they apply to. With scope event (default) event_id is required. Read-only.

organization_id.description: Organization id from eventbrite_list_my_organizations (not the organizer id).

scope.description: event (codes of one event, needs event_id), multi_events or user.

event_id.description: Event id; required for scope event.

code.description: Only the code with exactly this name.

code_filter.description: Only codes containing this text (not together with code).

type.description: Only this kind: coded (discount code), access (access code), public (public discount) or hold.

continuation.description: pagination.continuation from the previous answer, for the next page (only while has_more_items is true).

tools.name: eventbrite_get_sales_report
tools.description: Get a sales report for one or more events: gross, net, quantity, fees and royalty per period (day by default), optionally grouped by ticket, payment method, currency, country, sales channel and more. Read-only.

event_ids.description: Event ids to report on, e.g. ["123456789"].

event_status.description: Limit to events with this status.

date_facet.description: Period per row: fifteen, hour, day (default), event_day, week, month, year or none (one total).

group_by.description: Break out by: ticket, payment_method, currency, event, country, city, sales_channel_lvl_1, delivery_method and others.

timezone.description: Timezone of the dates, e.g. Europe/Berlin; default the first event's timezone.
